title: LAMP Assay
author: Niels Appelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jahuie

steps.title: Prepare 10X Primer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10X primermix according to the provided scheme.

steps.title: Assemble Reaction
steps.instruction: Add the required components to a microcentrifuge tube, including a no-template control to ensure template-specificity.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions at 65 C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Record the color of all samples; yellowing indicates a positive result.

steps.title: Verify Ambiguous Results
steps.instruction: If the result of a sample is doubtful, run it on an agarose gel.

substeps.instruction: Confirm positive result by the presence of many bands, which may not be individually recognizable.
